rationale: The Court is likely to issue a narrow opinion upholding the MRT as a Sixteenth Amendment income tax because the taxed earnings were realized at the corporate level and Congress may attribute that realized income to shareholders, while cabining Macomber to stock dividends. Justice Thomas is likely to write a lone originalist dissent insisting on shareholder-level realization/receipt and characterizing the MRT as an unapportioned direct tax on property.
